title: QLaunchpad layout document
description: Versioned Launchpad layout (schemaVersion 1). Kind must be qlaunchpad.layout. Does not include settings such as customApplicationSourcePaths, hotkeys, or gridLayoutPreset writes. Import never applies catalog as layout.

kind.description: Magic string. Any other value is rejected.

schemaVersion.description: Positive integer. v1 decoder accepts only 1; missing or greater than 1 is rejected.

exportedAt.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp from export. Import ignores this field.

appVersion.description: CFBundleShortVersionString of the exporting binary. Import ignores this field.

grid.description: Read-only snapshot of the target domain gridLayoutPreset. Import does not write this setting. Page 1 is items[0 .. pageCapacity).

items.description: Root grid left-to-right, top-to-bottom, continuous across pages. Same identity space as launchpadItemOrder.

hidden.description: If present, replaces hiddenAppIdentifiers with the resolved ids. If omitted, keep the live hidden set minus ids claimed by items / folder apps (implicit unhide). Must not overlap items or folder apps.

catalog.description: Scanned apps at export time, including hidden ones. Import never adds catalog entries to the grid; catalog is only a resolver hint (step 3) and a name lookup for agents.

preset.description: GridLayoutPreset raw value, e.g. 6x4-128. Unknown or missing values export as 6x4-128.

id.description: AppInfo.id (bundle identifier, or bundle#standardizedPath for extra copies). Not the display name.
Optional. Missing or blank becomes folder-<UUID> on import. Prefer keeping an existing folder id.

name.description: Required. Non-strict import maps a blank trimmed name to 文件夹. --strict fails on a blank name.

apps.description: Member AppInfo.id values in folder order. Must not reference another folder id. Empty folders are dropped by reconcile.

name.description: Display name for humans / agents. Never used as a primary key.
